name: Kah'lil Soheil
source:
A punished god reincarnated.
Kah'lil is prominente info-broker and borrower(?).
He temporarely borrows things and returns them
once he's bored of it.

He loves cute things and the Hell'A Kitty series.
Friendly, fun loving and a bit cowardly.
He knows Guntur quite well.
